card_config.value: Add this card to your hand, or if you have the required energy, perform Raid with it.

card_set: Booster Pack Evangelion: New Theatrical Edition [UE15BT]
card_text:
【Raid】 <Asuka Shikinami Langley> Switch to active. May move to the front line.
At the end of this character's attack, you may place four [WILLE] affinity cards from your sideline into your removal area. If you do, switch this character to active, give it 3000 BP and "This character cannot be blocked by a character with 3000 or less BP" until the end of the turn, and place the base card of this Raided character into your sideline.
[When Played] If there are two or more characters on your opponent's front line with BP less than their base BP, this character gains 【Double Attack】 until the end of the turn.

regulations.title: One Battle Rule Evangelion: New Theatrical Edition
